metadata.description: Community plugins for productivity and academic workflows

plugins.name: u-flow
plugins.description: Academic productivity for university students: organize course material, research with your catedra's sources, write reports and presentations against the real consigna, and generate study aids — in Spanish, grounded in your own course files

plugins.name: u-student
plugins.description: Academic assistant for university and course students — study, summarize, create presentations, write TPs, simulate exams, and prepare oral defenses. Organized around your own course material (cronograma, programa) and always responds in Spanish.
